title: Enterprise Guardrail Wizard for Customer Routing Templates
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an interactive "Guardrail Wizard" inside the Console Policy Editor that helps enterprise customers author and validate region/tier routing policies with enforced safety checks and fallback model variant simulations. The feature should: provide a step-by-step template flow for creating enterprise-safe routing policies, run deterministic validation and a probabilistic scenario simulator (traffic mix, cost/latency modeling), suggest fallback model variants by SLA and cost, and produce an exportable preflight checklist for legal/security review.
acceptance_criteria: Wizard UI integrated into Console policy editor as a new 'Enterprise Guardrail' path
Policy templates include region constraints, tier ordering, and explicit fallback variant bindings
Validation engine runs and surfaces errors/warnings inline (latency targets, unsupported variants per region, cost anomalies)
Scenario simulator can replay synthetic traffic mixes and produce per-route SLA, median latency, and estimated token cost for 3 sample traffic profiles
Exportable preflight report generates PDF/JSON including validation errors, recommended mitigations, and security checklist
Feature guarded by permission 'policy:author-enterprise' and triggers security review workflow when enabled
